title: MV The Deep Blue: A surreal, psychological horror RPG

posts.author: rowannullart
posts.body:
Developed by:
rowannullart
Created on:
3/8/25
Genre:
Surreal/Psychological Horror/Puzzle
Engine Used:
RPG MAKER MV
Spoiler
This game contains depictions of anxiety, depression, suicide, and self harm,
and my not be suitable for all audiences.
Players with photosensitivity are advised to take caution while playing this game
due to flashing, and very bright lights.
Spoiler
The Deep Blue, is a story of a boy who has awoken in a strange new world, with no memories of his prior life.
Join Null as you traverse this odd land. Meet new friends, fight daring foes, and most important of all uncover fragments of your past, long forgotten, in the form of diary pages.
Don't you worry though, your friends are all here for you, they've got your back until the very end.
That's what they've always said. R
ight?
As you progress deeper into darker waters you'll soon find out this world is not what it seems.
Nightmarish creatures loom around every corner, the world seems to be falling apart at the seams, and you are the only one who can fix the damage that has been done.
Will you do it,
or will you let the abyss consume you?
Spoiler
Inspired by greats such as Omori and Yume Nikki, The Deep Blue combines an RPG experience full of fun puzzles, quests, and battles with dreamy exploration-based segments that will keep you entertained for hours on end.
- Multiple endings
- Exploration based segments
- Fun yet challenging puzzles
- Original pixel art by rowannullart & ley
- Original soundtrack by Luca M.
The Deep Blue is estimated to take around a year to develop, and will be released commercially on Steam,
with a FREE demo expected to be released around June of 2025.
